limitations: This review recomputed consistency and hashes; it does not authenticate external observations or establish the truth of a scanner's undiscovered findings.
Operation cleanup, empty owned-container listing, browser behavior and command exits are retained observations from the coordinator; no fresh runtime or Docker query was made by this reviewer.

Historical baseline metadata was compared with prior public receipts. The private live evidence store was not read, so its post-handoff byte preservation remains the coordinator's recorded observation.
Replays use fresh containers on the same host. They are not independent-machine verification.
Scripted mock outcomes establish local workflow behavior, not model performance, policy advantage or scored experiment results.
CPU consumption is unmeasured. Provider account, pricing, isolation, cancellation and billing remain unverified; human review, calibrated experiments and owner release gates remain open.

No sealed evaluator material, private corpus, credentials or private state was inspected. No provider/network request, scan, candidate execution, Docker operation or test execution occurred during this artifact review.
